photos.title: Beanie Season & Matching Rings
photos.caption: First cold snap in Seoul. He borrowed my knit beanie and insisted on taking a mirror selfie to show off our promise rings in the warm lighting.

photos.title: Monochrome Editorial Duo Cut
photos.caption: The photographer told us to look aloof and mysterious, but every time the camera flashed, Anxinie kept whispering silly jokes behind my back.

photos.title: Matching Promise Rings & Outtakes
photos.caption: Manager Park looked away for two seconds and Anxinie immediately broke character to poke my cheek. Our matching silver rings were engraved 'S ♡ A' for 1204.

photos.title: Midnight Melody Back Hug
photos.caption: He was struggling with the high falsetto transition on Track 4. I came up behind him at the keyboard and told him to breathe with me until his pulse calmed down.

photos.title: Catching Your Laughter
photos.caption: Whenever I hug him from behind like this, he always buries his face in my sleeves laughing. That laughter is my whole world.

photos.title: Comeback Teaser Duo Unit
photos.caption: Official unit photo for the repackage album. Fans called our chemistry electric—if only they knew how real it was.

photos.title: Post-Shoot Double V
photos.caption: 'We\'re finally done!' Anxinie threw up double peace signs right before dragging me to get hot tteokbokki.

photos.title: Tokyo Tower Midnight Stroll
photos.caption: We sneaked out from the hotel after the Tokyo Dome soundcheck. The city lights were breathtaking, but I couldn\'t take my eyes off him.

photos.title: Cozy Dorm Sweater Weather
photos.caption: Wearing our softest oversized sweaters after a 12-hour choreo rehearsal. Just staying quiet together in the dark.

photos.title: Warmth Before Sleep
photos.caption: He always gets cold after showering. Squeezing him close until his hands warm up.

photos.title: Hoodie Season Morning Routine
photos.caption: Early morning music show pre-recording call time. Still half asleep, leaning into each other.

photos.title: Green Room Rehearsal Break
photos.caption: Drinking iced peach americanos between dry rehearsals while reviewing our harmony cues.

photos.title: Sub-Zero Incheon Walk
photos.caption: Freezing minus 5 degrees outside. Buried inside long padded parkas, marching towards our flight to Osaka.

photos.title: Encore High: Double Cheek Hearts
photos.caption: Adrenaline still pumping after the 3-hour stadium concert. Sangwon\'s blonde hair messy, Anxinie glowing.

photos.title: Setlist Last Check
photos.caption: Reviewing the stage blocking on Sangwon\'s phone five minutes before the live broadcast.

photos.title: Autumn Collegiate Concept
photos.caption: Felt like college sweethearts for an afternoon during this campus season\'s greetings photoshoot.

photos.title: Tour Van Highway Daze
photos.caption: Heading back from the Daejeon festival. The other members fell asleep within five minutes.

photos.title: Dance Studio Golden Hour
photos.caption: When the golden sunset streams through the mirrored hall and Anxinie wraps his arms around my neck.

photos.title: Hidden Alley Embrace
photos.caption: Away from dispatch cameras and manager eyes. Just one quiet hug under the autumn streetlamp.

photos.title: Studio Sanctuary (Duo Take)
photos.caption: No matter how tired our muscles ache after 8 hours of dancing, being in your arms washes it all away.

photos.title: Secret Back Pocket Touch
photos.caption: We couldn\'t hold hands openly in public, so he slipped his fingers secretly into my back pocket as we walked.

photos.title: 3 AM Convenience Store Run
photos.caption: Horn-rimmed glasses, messy hair, buying banana milk and ramen after a midnight recording session.

photos.title: Intertwined Under the Blanket
photos.caption: Fingers laced together in the dark. The unspoken promise that we\'re never letting go.

photos.title: Flight KE001: 35,000 Feet
photos.caption: Shared window seat on the 11-hour flight to LA. Sangwon stayed awake so Anxin could sleep on his shoulder.

photos.title: Our Secret Frequency (Acoustic Guide)
photos.caption: White wired earphone cords tangled between our collars. Listening to the acoustic demo of 'Song for A.'

photos.title: Window Seat Gaze
photos.caption: 'Stop taking photos and sleep, Anxinie.' But I never looked away from his lens.

photos.title: Holding Hands in the Shadows
photos.caption: Where the city lights couldn\'t reach us. Our palms warm against the crisp autumn breeze.

photos.title: Matching 'Boyfriend' Tees (Secretly)
photos.caption: We bought these as a silly joke in Harajuku. Wore them inside the private villa where no cameras could see.

photos.title: The Dorm Alley Cat
photos.caption: This stray orange cat always waits outside the convenience store. Anxinie spent 15 minutes feeding it canned tuna.

photos.title: Post-Soundcheck Glow
photos.caption: Microphones taped to our ears, stage makeup set. One quick photo before opening doors to 40,000 fans.

photos.title: Harmony Center Stage
photos.caption: Under the blinding spotlights, singing our duo bridge. The only thing that calms my racing heart is hearing his voice beside me.

photos.title: Backstage Ethereal Look
photos.caption: The stylist gave Anxinie this peach blossom blush. Sangwon stared for so long the hair director started teasing them.

photos.title: Pinky Promise at Cloud Level
photos.caption: 'Let\'s conquer the world tour together, hyung.' Our matching promise rings tapping together against the airplane window.

photos.title: Wardrobe Fitting Mirror
photos.caption: Trying on customized tour stage outfits. Anxinie kept adjusting Sangwon\'s collar to make sure it sat straight.

photos.title: Exhausted Slumber
photos.caption: Crashed into bed without even changing out of sweatpants after 14 hours of dance practice. He looked so small curled under the blanket.

photos.title: Lazy Sunday in the Dorm
photos.caption: Rare day off with no schedules. No alarms, no managers, just listening to indie vinyl records on the floor.

photos.title: Peach Blossom Aesthetic (Angle B)
photos.caption: Another sweet candid saved to Sangwon\'s hidden album. Anxinie\'s pure gaze straight into the camera.

photos.title: Hold Me Close (Cashmere Knits)
photos.caption: Soft wool against skin. When words aren\'t needed at the end of an exhausting week.

photos.title: Twin Visuals: Rehearsal Focus
photos.caption: Checking monitor audio together. The harmony between our voices is something that took years to weave.

photos.title: Height Check Shenanigans
photos.caption: Anxinie stood on his tiptoes swearing he grew another centimeter this month. Sangwon couldn\'t stop teasing him.

photos.title: Film Camera Memories (90s Grain)
photos.caption: Found a disposable 35mm camera at a thrift shop. The developed film came out looking like 90s cinema.

photos.title: Midnight Streetlamp Embrace
photos.caption: Walking back to the dorm after midnight. Pulling him into a deep hug where no fans could follow.

photos.title: Shadow Kiss on Pavement
photos.caption: Our shadows told the truth the world wasn\'t ready to see yet. A secret kiss projected on the asphalt.

photos.title: Echoes of Light (Concept Duo)
photos.caption: The official concept portrait that drove the fandom into a frenzy. Sangwon kept this uncropped high-res copy on his phone.

photos.title: Highway Smiles in the Van
photos.caption: Long drives are bearable only because you\'re sitting right beside me.

photos.title: Late Night Video Call Screen
photos.caption: When Anxin had to fly back to China for 3 days to renew his visa. Neither of us hung up until 4 AM.

photos.title: Composing Together in Bed
photos.caption: Logic Pro open on the MacBook, fine-tuning vocal harmonies while sharing a bowl of strawberries.

photos.title: School Uniform Concept Nostalgia
photos.caption: 'What if we had met back in high school, hyung?' Anxinie asked while untying his uniform collar.

photos.title: Bookstore Hide and Seek
photos.caption: Hiding our faces behind photography art books when tourists walked by our aisle.

photos.title: My Anchor, My Home
photos.caption: Simple white tees, no makeup, no stage persona. Just Anxin resting his tired head on my shoulder.

photos.title: Special Stage Encore Cap
photos.caption: Right after our winning performance. Wearing the stage captain caps and celebrating backstage.

photos.title: Unbroken Devotion
photos.caption: 'Even under thousands of stage spotlights, my eyes only search for you.' The gaze that never wavers.

photos.title: Passionate Red: Duo Harmony
photos.caption: Our red-and-black contrast concept. The stylists said our contrast was perfection.

photos.title: Sunset by the Han River
photos.caption: Sangwon walking along the riverbank in his tailored jacket after the solo choreography shoot. Anxin was waiting behind the camera.

photos.title: Couch Giggles in the Small Studio
photos.caption: Anxin sent this to me: 'Look at you trying to hide your face, hyung!' That afternoon we were curled up together on the black leather couch in the small vocal room, laughing and playing until we lost track of time.

photos.title: Looking Up at You (Sent by Anxin)
photos.caption: Anxin took this from above while standing over the couch. Messy hair falling in my eyes, power bank and AirPods scattered around us while we played our favorite mobile games and shared snacks.

notes.title: ALD1 World Tour - Rehearsal & Vocal Setlist
notes.snippet: Opening: Track 01 'Supernova' -> Duo Center Unit with Anxinie...
notes.content:
ALD1 WORLD TOUR 2026-2027 REHEARSAL CHECKLIST
=============================================
1. Opening Stage: 'Supernova' (Formation 3 -> 1)
2. Title Track: 'Echoes of Light' (Live vocal mic gain +2dB)
3. Duo Stage (Sangwon & Anxin):
   - Rehearse the hand-reach transition at bridge 02:45
   - Check in-ear monitor mix (pan Anxin's vocal to my left ear)
   - Don't linger holding hands too long on the revolving riser—Manager Park warned us fans were screaming last soundcheck.
4. Encore: Acoustic medley with lightstick wave.

notes.title: Little Things to Remember About Anxinie 🤍
notes.snippet: Peach iced tea, hates cucumbers, gets homesick when winter begins...
notes.content:
THINGS ANXINIE LOVES & NEEDS:
- Loves peach iced tea (50% sugar, less ice).
- Hates cucumbers with a passion (pick them out of kimbap for him).
- When he misses Chongqing or his family, make tomato egg noodles late at night.
- Always gets cold hands after music show dry runs—keep hand warmers in my bag.
- Loves sleeping on the left side of our bed facing the window.
- Needs gentle hugs when choreo practice gets overwhelming.
- Tells me 'Wo ai ni' in Chinese whenever he thinks I'm asleep.

notes.title: Private Diary - For Anxinie (500 Days)
notes.snippet: LOCKED NOTE • Our secret rooftop confession & promise.
notes.pinHint: Hint: Our anniversary date (1204 = December 4th on the rooftop ring)!
notes.content:
TO MY ANXINIE (500 DAYS TOGETHER)
===================================
December 4th.

Two years ago on that freezing dorm rooftop, when you handed me your scarf and confessed that you liked me, I was terrified. We were rookies about to debut in ALD1, and the entire world expected us to be flawless, untouchable idols.

Every day since then, keeping our love hidden has been our sweetest, most precious secret. When we stand together on stadium stages before tens of thousands of fans, hearing you harmonize next to me gives me courage I never knew I had.

I promise you, Anxinie:
No matter how chaotic this industry gets, no matter how many schedules they throw at us, I will always be your home. When the cameras turn off and the lights go down, I am just Sangwon, and you are my whole heart.

Happy 500 days, my love.

— Sangwon (상원)
